pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, non-uniform polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edge gradients exhibit moderate softening; patch centers are slightly lighter than the periphery. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger units on the upper neck/torso and smaller, more compact units on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lattice of light-colored negative space separating dark patches. Junction nodes exhibit increased pixel width compared to narrow linear segments. The network is continuous across the visible flank with high topological connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The contour is composed of discrete tufts creating a jagged 1D edge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark-colored birds (oxpeckers) perched on the lateral-dorsal region of the mid-neck, creating localized occlusion of the underlying pelage.
